column8: Mon 16 Nov: 3c and Table 2 note context, the base ban and its exceptions; exception (iv) is approved (SEC order, 15 Oct 2026) but not yet in force, say so; mapping owned arithmetic to (i) is loose, (i) covers illustrations that project no investment.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and Table 2 note; approval date and the three conditions checked in the SEC order (34-106675, 15 Oct 2026), but effective date seen only in a law-firm note (S capped at 2); never say brokers may now project; FINRA dropped the express net-of-fees disclosure; twin in spirit of Q29-027.

Mon 16 Nov: 3d and 3c, the regulators' audience line (fn 113 and the mass-audience text checked in the SEC order) matches the plan's rule that co-sponsors hear only owned figures; say it as a parallel of principle, co-sponsors are institutions, not mass retail.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and 3d presentation, enforcement shows a modelled figure grabs the eye (2023-173 quote and $850,000 checked); advertising cases, support only for keeping medians out of headline sentences.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c, FINRA FAQ D.6 checked: a metric needing a valuation estimate is a projection, so owned ends counted from holdings' remaining flows are not; private-placement context, use as the test, not as a binding rule.
Mon 16 Nov: 3c wording, SEC adopting release definitions checked (targeted = aspirational, projected = estimate); gives the report its two banned words for the range (target; projection once owned).

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and Table 2 note, label 7.5% as J.P. Morgan's world-share forecast with its date (market forecast not a portfolio projection: release text checked); J.P. Morgan excerpt only (S 3); upper third of fifteen houses, never the top or the consensus; never in Laura's words.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c tense split, SEC reason checked (avoid investors thinking such performance is guaranteed; assumptions include the likelihood of an event); owned figures may be called guaranteed (Book 19), modelled ones carry counts.
Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note, names each column's kind (house model projected, the two replays backtested); adds the column mapping to Q29-026's definition.
Mon 16 Nov: 2.5, the market-wide-gain reason why WInS gains say nothing about the strategy, the regulator's form of Wharton's rule; one clause at most.
Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note, confirms the range already charges Laura's own fees (0.07% from the trade day, 0.15% waiting, 0.5% beyond: NUMBERS 0); WInS commissions stay with the simulator.
Mon 16 Nov: 2.1 or 3a, terms (coupon, face) are a different kind of figure from returns; the staff takes no position, so a minor support only.

Mon 16 Nov: 2.1, brokers label estimated income as estimates because holdings and issuers' payments change; supports never fixed for an iBond fund's payout (TNA l.13), plain statement for a Treasury held to its date.
Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note and 3c, V(B) guidance checked (separate fact from statistical conjecture; output an estimate not a certainty); adds to Q34-011; never praise the model's accuracy.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c, Dox checked (a calculation is a quantitative opinion, not a fact): the same $95,000 is modelled today and owned from January 2028. Clash reading correct (CANON C6, D10; NUMBERS 4 house 1-in-20 bottom today $85,000); add that shares never move the bottom even today, only yields to January 2028.
Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 and Exhibit 3, Thomas checked (balanced rising and falling rates); keep both January 2028 yield rows ($80,000-$100,000 and $110,000-$135,000, NUMBERS 4).

Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note, Ramon checked (VaR depends on inputs; disclose how they were chosen); the note names 17.88%, 0.9 point a year independent of shares, 200,000 runs; overlaps Q37 r25, adds the reason.
Mon 16 Nov: 3a and 2.1, CFA I(C) guidance checked: guarantees built into the product are outside the ban, so guaranteed for a Treasury held to its date sits inside the profession's code (Book 19).

Mon 16 Nov: 3a, Abdrabbo checked (guaranteed appropriate within the insured limit; the interest is not guaranteed): say what is guaranteed and that cash waiting is counted at zero, which is the payments' standard.

Mon 16 Nov: 2.1, 3a and 3c, Marks checked (IOs sold as US-government guaranteed broke the standard): guaranteed goes on the Treasuries inside, never on an iBond fund's payout (net asset value, TNA l.13); the stated ends hold by the zero-interest count less 0.5%.
Mon 16 Nov: 2.5 and Table 2, GIPS: never splice actual WInS results onto a model path; label looking-back and looking-forward columns, each after fees.

Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 and 3c, COBS 4.6.7: forward figures not based on simulated past performance, both scenarios shown, warning only on modelled figures; card itself corrects the paraphrase to not a reliable indicator.
Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note, a UK reason for the existing label US stocks from July 1929, never world shares (Shiller to Jun 2023, NUMBERS 0); restates a rule already in NUMBERS.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e, why no building-cost projection: no objective data, and the case leaves the cost out of scope; the report tests rises against her flexibility (NUMBERS 8q).

Mon 16 Nov: 3e, one line that every figure is in US dollars while the building is paid in Taiwan dollars, beside the 10% stronger Taiwan dollar test (NUMBERS 8j); past-performance rule, principle only.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and Table 2 note, COBS 13 Annex 2 1.1R checked (rounded down, no more than three significant figures): why the ends are round; the plan's $5,000 steps are coarser than the UK's, say so.
Mon 16 Nov: 3c, COBS 13 Annex 2 2.4R(3) checked (substitute the obligated rate): what is owed by contract replaces the model, as the bought floor replaces the modelled bottom.
Mon 16 Nov: 3c and WORDS, COBS 13 Annex 2 section 5 checked (degree figures can be relied upon; explanation adjacent on the same page; might in the heading): basis beside each modelled figure.

Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 note, the 3-point differential checked; Keel's 4%-10% test is roughly that (minus 3.5, plus 2.5); top stays $115,000 ($116,211-$119,478, NUMBERS 4); the middle-rate wording and maximum rates not seen.
Mon 16 Nov: 3c, the EU's 2017 scenarios made a model's low end look like a guarantee; before January 2028 the bottom is modelled (house 1-in-20 $85,000, NUMBERS 4); PDF excerpt only (S 3).

Mon 16 Nov: Table 2 and Exhibit 3, recitals 2-3 and elements B, C, E checked at eur-lex; fix the use: 1871-2023 and 585 windows are two histories (stock history 1,770 windows since 1871; joint replay 585 windows since 1962).

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and 3e, checked at eur-lex: Annex IV point 4 (minimum shown not taking into account the payer unable to pay) and element G hold; fix the citation: the monetary-amount sentence is Annex V Part 1 point 3(b), element G is in Part 2; the ends hold if held to 15 Dec 2032 and costs beyond fees stay within 0.5% (NUMBERS 4).

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and 3d, a regulator removed model scenarios that misled: fewer forward figures, each with a job, none for co-sponsors; PDF excerpts only (S 3); the FCA kept them for structured products.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of Q71-023 (S-K Item 10(b) range wording); its additions are weak: Keel's own second bootstrap is not an outside review in S-K's sense, so never call it one.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of Q18-026 (safe harbour, meaningful cautionary statements naming factors); the one addition (assumptions are forward-looking, so 7.5% carries owner and date) is row 7's job.
Mon 16 Nov: 27 Nov writers' label map; fix: the ten's $302,287 is MODEL (engine on the 6 Nov curve, NUMBERS 1), not a market-price fact, so it takes priced on or we modelled; Keel synthesis (S 3).

Mon 16 Nov: 3c and CONCEIT, the tense rule; fix: at the 6 Nov curve the payments are not finished in January 2027 only if yields fell: the top-up ($2,287) and extra Treasuries ($35,894) are bought January 2028 regardless, so most of each payment owned January 2027, the rest January 2028; clash reading as row 15 is correct; Keel synthesis (S 3).

Mon 16 Nov: 3c, certain after the move with its reason in one clause; fix the limit to NUMBERS 4's words: a cost of 0.75% (not above it) breaks an end in about 1 house path in 17; Keel synthesis (S 3).
Mon 16 Nov: twin of Q71-024 (a could-be-lower warning on owned holdings would be false); V(B) from the other side and the EU's default-apart line are rows 14 and 32.
